_comment: Flight controls of the manual aircraft from joysticks, throttles and pedals (see README.md), read when FlightSim starts. Device names and axis and button numbers as shown by Tools/joysticks.py. Each control comes from the keyboard while its device is not connected.
_axes: Axis values as shown by Tools/joysticks.py: roll -1 left to 1 right, pitch -1 forward (nose down) to 1 back (nose up), throttle -1 idle to 1 full, rudder -1 left to 1 right. invert reverses an axis, deadzone sets the values closer to the center to zero (as fraction of the half range).
